product_name: High-End French Satin Silk Evening Gown with Thigh Slit

concept_options.title: Camera Flash Stress Test: Cheap Satin vs. French Silk
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Women aged 22-35 attending formal evening banquets, weddings, and high-profile parties

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Đừng mặc lụa bóng rẻ tiền đi tiệc nếu không muốn lộ hết khuyết điểm!
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Direct camera flash hits two gowns side-by-side: cheap satin glares blindingly white, while French satin silk reflects a liquid hourglass sheen.
hook_strategy.on_screen_text: CẢNH BÁO: MẶC LỤA BÓNG ĐI TIỆC!
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: Fear of public wardrobe failure under camera flashes and visual curiosity

narrative_arc: 0-3s: Presenter triggers phone flash directly at cheap satin (blinding glare) vs. French silk gown (subtle liquid glow).
3-7s: Show how ordinary satin static-clings to stomach and wrinkles instantly when sitting down at banquet tables.
7-15s: Model puts on the French Silk Gown; presenter performs the 30-Minute Sit & Stride Test—zero belly wrinkles, waist instantly sculpted.
15-20s: Demonstrates the precision high-thigh slit angle—walks and sits confidently with zero fear of over-exposing.
20-25s: Price drop call-out: High-end French Silk Gown now only 890,000 VND (down 26%) for party season.
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Visual proof through stress testing eliminates online fabric skepticism and proves superior quality before purchase.

concept_options.title: Liquid Glass Silk: Tactile Luxury Experience
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Aspirationally-driven women seeking high-end luxury aesthetic and premium sensory quality

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Cảm giác khoác lên mình dòng nước mát lạnh dưới ánh đèn tiệc...
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Macro camera glides over French satin silk draped on skin, capturing tactile fabric sound and warm chandelier light reflection.
hook_strategy.on_screen_text: LỤA PHÁP CAO CẤP • THẦN THÁI BỮA TIỆC
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: Visual dopamine and high-end aesthetic luxury aspiration

narrative_arc: 0-3s: ASMR macro crisp fabric swoosh as hand glides over ultra-smooth French satin silk with liquid-like drape.
3-7s: Cinematic slow-motion tracking shot of model stepping into grand ballroom; soft sheen highlights hourglass silhouette.
7-15s: Extreme close-up on anti-static inner lining gliding over leg, demonstrating zero cling and cool comfort.
15-20s: Slow turn showcasing precision side slit elongating legs gracefully without awkward riding up.
20-25s: Elegant endcard displaying special event pricing of 890,000 VND with shop now button.
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Sensory visual immersion triggers aspirational buying emotions and perceived value far above the 890,000 VND price point.

concept_options.title: 3 Evening Gown Nightmares Fixed
concept_options.target_audience_segment: Practical women seeking comfortable, body-flattering evening wear without fit anxiety

hook_strategy.spoken_hook: Đi tiệc mà vừa ngồi xuống đầm đã nhăn nhúm, dính chặt vào bụng?
hook_strategy.visual_hook: Split screen showing cheap dress bunching up at waist vs. French Silk gown staying pristine.
hook_strategy.on_screen_text: 3 NỖI ÁC MỘNG KHI MẶC ĐẦM DỰ TIỆC
hook_strategy.retention_trigger: Relatable problem identification and frustration agitation

narrative_arc: 0-3s: Split screen dramatization: Relatable pain of satin dresses wrinkling at stomach and awkward static cling.
3-7s: Direct agitation of fear: Slits that cut too high when sitting down or fabric looking cheap under photography light.
7-15s: Hard feature solution: Tailored contouring waist, precision 45-degree slit cut, anti-static lining, and wrinkle-resistant silk blend.
15-20s: Side-by-side price comparison: Designer boutique dresses (3,500,000 VND) vs. Direct-to-Consumer French Silk Gown (890,000 VND).
20-25s: Call to action with free size exchange guarantee and limited 26% discount offer.
concept_options.conversion_thesis: Direct comparison dismantling major friction points builds immediate practical rationalization to buy.

winning_concept.selection_rationale: Angle A wins due to the high visual skepticism around online satin purchases in Vietnam (fear of cheap synthetic shine, belly wrinkles, and inappropriate slits). The 'Camera Flash Stress Test' creates an immediate pattern interrupt in feeds, instantly debunking objections with clear side-by-side visual evidence while driving a compelling 890,000 VND value proposition.

directorial_directives.camera_pacing: Fast kinetic whip pans into locked macro push-ins during flash tests
directorial_directives.lighting_mood: High-contrast commercial studio with hard direct strobe flash toggling into warm banquet ambient light
directorial_directives.key_visual_anchor: Direct phone flash firing point-blank against the gown fabric demonstrating non-glare liquid silk sheen
